description: §19.16.3 rule 4 — `defer` in a `when @n changes { }` body is E-DEFER-OUTSIDE-FUNCTION, exactly once. A `when` body is a reactive-effect body, not a function-declaration body, and it is lowered as text. Before S432 the default front-end compiled `defer [1, 2].forEach(note)` there CLEAN and emitted `defer[…]` (a runtime ReferenceError); `defer note("d")` / `defer @t = …` crashed codegen (E-CODEGEN-INVALID-LOGIC).
rationale: §19.16.3 rule 4: `defer` SHALL appear only inside the body of a function DECLARATION (`function`, `fn`, `server function`), including any block nested in one; it is E-DEFER-OUTSIDE-FUNCTION in every other position.
